# states

Declare the state names available to a state machine.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `section.states` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Runtime Sections |
| Family | State Machine |
| Monaco kind | `section` |
| Format | `states:` |
| Valid contexts | `task_state_machine.root` |
| Autocomplete | `states:<br>    idle<br>    running<br>` |

## Example

```lua
states:
    idle
    running
```
